DEVICE_SHARES.description: KV namespace used to store short-lived platform10 device handoff records.

APP_METADATA.description: KV namespace for published download metadata such as the latest public platform10 build URL and version.

APP_NAME.description: Public name shown on the share pages. The default is platform10.

APP_URL_SCHEME.description: Custom URL scheme for the platform10 deep link. The default is platform10.

DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional fallback public download URL for platform10 when the APP_METADATA KV key latest-download has not been set yet.

DOWNLOAD_VERSION.description: Optional fallback version label shown next to the download button.

DOWNLOAD_BUILD_LABEL.description: Optional fallback build label or channel text shown next to the download button.

TUNNEL_BASE_DOMAIN.description: Base hostname used for platform10 Share public tunnels, for example share.platform10.uk.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID used by the tunnel broker API.

CF_ZONE_ID.description: Cloudflare DNS zone ID used to create public tunnel hostnames.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Secret Cloudflare API token with permission to manage Cloudflare Tunnel and DNS records.
